name: 2S1P · 2 × 18650 · wire leads
description: 2 cylindrical 18650 cells; series holder with wire leads.

geometryEvidence.summary: BeiLaMoo BH18650*2S-W: 77.7 × 40.21 × 21.54 mm body; 2 cells; 150 mm 22 AWG wire leads; source-dimension reconstruction without wires.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Installation reconstruction using the MPD holder geometry as a declared reference for the matching published outer envelope. PCB pin tails are removed and wire exits inferred from photographs; external wires, internal busbars and solder joints are omitted. The BeiLaMoo mounting-hole pattern and fine moulding details are not manufacturer-verified. The maker specifies series connection in text, while its reused photograph bears a parallel marking; verify the ordered wiring execution.
